results.rationale: Consistency: people and lawn remain recognizable, but the existing top-middle and middle-left O tiles become X tiles and several tiles rotate or move. Instruction: an X is added at bottom-middle instead of the empty top-left cell required to complete the original diagonal. A column win is obtained only by changing an existing O, so the requested legal winning placement is poorly implemented. Knowledge: the original board is not solved by a valid single move. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: lawn, people, tiles and symbols are visually coherent.

Consistency: horizon, sky and clouds remain in place, but offshore wave and foam patterns are noticeably redrawn beyond the beach surface. Instruction: sand is replaced by a continuous pebble shoreline, fully matching a shingle beach. Knowledge: rounded stones and coarse mixed sediment are plainly visible. Quality: pebbles have coherent depth and lighting, though the thin foam band has slightly repetitive granular texture.
